messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

At the beginning the customer perceives that her subscribed service has degraded. A list with all the problem parameters is then sent to the Customer Service department of TELECO. At the customer service an employee enters (based on the received data) a problem report into system T.. Then the problem report is compared to the customer SLA to identify what the extent and the details of the service degradation are. Based on this, the necessary counter measures are determined including their respective priorities. An electronic service then determines the significance of the customer based on information that has been collected during the history of the contractual relationship. In case the customer is premium, the process will link to an extra problem fix process (this process will not be detailed here). In case the customer is of certain significance which would affect the counter measures previously decided upon, the process goes back to re-prioritize these measures otherwise the process continues. Taking together the information (i.e. contract commitment data + prioritized actions) a detailed problem report is created. The detailed problem report is then sent to Service Management. Service Management deals on a first level with violations of quality in services that are provided to customers. After receiving the detailed problem report, Service management investigates whether the problem is analyzable at the level of their department or whether the problem may be located at Resource Provisioning. In case Service Management assesses the problem to be not analyzable by themselves, the detailed problem report is sent out to Resource Provisioning. If Service Management is sure they can analyze it, they perform the analysis and based on the outcome they create a trouble report that indicates the type of problem. After Resource Provisioning receives the detailed problem report, it is checked whether there are any possible problems. If no problems are detected, a notification about the normal service execution is created. If a problem is detected this will be analyzed by Resource Provisioning and a trouble report is created. Either trouble report or the normal execution notification will be included in a status report and sent back to Service Management. Service Management then prepares the final status report based on the received information. Subsequently it has to be determined what counter measures should be taken depending on the information in the final status report. Three alternative process paths may be taken. For the case that no problem was detected at all, the actual service performance is sent back to the Customer Service. For the case that minor corrective actions are required, Service Management will undertake corrective actions by themselves. Subsequently, the problem resolution report is created and then sent out to Customer Service. After sending, this process path of Service Management ends. For the case that automatic resource restoration from Resource Provisioning is required, Service Management must create a request for automatic resource restoration. This message is then sent to Resource Provisioning. Resource Provisioning has been on-hold and waiting for a restoration request but this must happen within 2 days after the status report was sent out, otherwise Resource Provisioning terminates the process. After the restoration request is received, all possible errors are tracked. Based on the tracked errors, all necessary corrective actions are undertaken by Resource Provisioning. Then a trouble-shooting report is created. This report is sent out to Service Management; then the process ends. The trouble-shooting report is received by Service Management and this information goes then into the creation of the problem resolution report just as described for ii). Customer Service either receives the actual service performance (if there was no problem) or the problem resolution report. Then, two concurrent activities are triggered, i.e. i) a report is created for the customer which details the current service performance and the resolution of the problem, and ii) an SLA violation rebate is reported to Billing & Collections who will adjust the billing. The report for the customer is sent out to her. After all three activities are completed the process ends within Customer Service. After the customer then receives the report about service performance and problem resolution from Customer Service, the process flow at the customer also ends.

<definitions xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

             xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI"
             xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"
             xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI"
             id="definitions_teleco_process"
             targetNamespace="http://www.example.org/bpmn/teleco"
             exporter="BPMN Expert"
             exporterVersion="1.0">

  <!-- ==================================================================== -->
  <!-- COLLABORATION                                                        -->
  <!-- ==================================================================== -->
  <collaboration id="collaboration_teleco">
    <participant id="participant_customer" name="Customer" processRef="process_customer" />
    <participant id="participant_teleco" name="TELECO" processRef="process_teleco" />
    <participant id="participant_billing" name="Billing & Collections" processRef="process_billing" />

    <!-- Message Flows -->
    <messageFlow id="msg_1" name="Problem Parameters" sourceRef="task_cust_send_params" targetRef="start_cs_msg" />
    <messageFlow id="msg_2" name="Detailed Problem Report" sourceRef="task_cs_send_detailed_report" targetRef="start_sm_msg" />
    <messageFlow id="msg_3" name="Detailed Problem Report" sourceRef="task_sm_send_rp_report" targetRef="start_rp_msg" />
    <messageFlow id="msg_4" name="Status Report" sourceRef="task_rp_send_status" targetRef="task_sm_receive_status" />
    <messageFlow id="msg_5" name="Restoration Request" sourceRef="task_sm_send_restoration_req" targetRef="catch_rp_restoration_req" />
    <messageFlow id="msg_6" name="Trouble-Shooting Report" sourceRef="task_rp_send_ts_report" targetRef="task_sm_receive_ts_report" />
    <messageFlow id="msg_7" name="Actual Performance" sourceRef="task_sm_send_perf_cs" targetRef="catch_cs_actual_perf" />
    <messageFlow id="msg_8" name="Problem Resolution Report" sourceRef="task_sm_send_resolution_cs" targetRef="catch_cs_resolution_rep" />
    <messageFlow id="msg_9" name="Performance & Resolution Report" sourceRef="task_cs_send_report_cust" targetRef="catch_cust_final_report" />
    <messageFlow id="msg_10" name="SLA Violation Rebate" sourceRef="task_cs_report_rebate" targetRef="start_billing_rebate" />
  </collaboration>

  <!-- ==================================================================== -->
  <!-- PROCESS: CUSTOMER                                                    -->
  <!-- ==================================================================== -->
  <process id="process_customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="true">
    <startEvent id="start_cust" name="Perceive Service Degradation">
      <outgoing>flow_c1</outgoing>
    </startEvent>

    <sendTask id="task_cust_send_params" name="Send Problem Parameters to Customer Service">
      <incoming>flow_c1</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_c2</outgoing>
    </sendTask>

    <receiveTask id="catch_cust_final_report" name="Receive Service Performance & Resolution Report">
      <incoming>flow_c2</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_c3</outgoing>
    </receiveTask>

    <endEvent id="end_cust" name="Customer Process Ended">
      <incoming>flow_c3</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <sequenceFlow id="flow_c1" sourceRef="start_cust" targetRef="task_cust_send_params" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_c2" sourceRef="task_cust_send_params" targetRef="catch_cust_final_report" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_c3" sourceRef="catch_cust_final_report" targetRef="end_cust" />
  </process>

  <!-- ==================================================================== -->
  <!-- PROCESS: BILLING & COLLECTIONS                                       -->
  <!-- ==================================================================== -->
  <process id="process_billing" name="Billing & Collections" isExecutable="true">
    <startEvent id="start_billing_rebate" name="Receive SLA Violation Rebate">
      <messageEventDefinition id="med_billing_start" />
      <outgoing>flow_b1</outgoing>
    </startEvent>

    <userTask id="task_billing_adjust" name="Adjust Billing">
      <incoming>flow_b1</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_b2</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <endEvent id="end_billing" name="Billing Adjusted">
      <incoming>flow_b2</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <sequenceFlow id="flow_b1" sourceRef="start_billing_rebate" targetRef="task_billing_adjust" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_b2" sourceRef="task_billing_adjust" targetRef="end_billing" />
  </process>

  <!-- ==================================================================== -->
  <!-- PROCESS: TELECO (COLLABORATIVE POOL WITH LANES)                      -->
  <!-- ==================================================================== -->
  <process id="process_teleco" name="TELECO" isExecutable="true">
    <laneSet id="laneSet_teleco">
      <lane id="lane_cs" name="Customer Service">
        <flowNodeRef>start_cs_msg</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_cs_enter_report</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_cs_compare_sla</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_cs_determine_countermeasures</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_cs_determine_significance</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>gateway_cs_premium</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>call_cs_extra_fix</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>gateway_cs_reprioritize_check</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_cs_reprioritize</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>gateway_cs_merge_reprioritize</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_cs_create_detailed_report</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_cs_send_detailed_report</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>gateway_cs_receive_type</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>catch_cs_actual_perf</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>catch_cs_resolution_rep</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>gateway_cs_merge_received</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>gateway_cs_parallel_split</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_cs_create_cust_report</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_cs_send_report_cust</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_cs_report_rebate</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>gateway_cs_parallel_join</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>end_cs</flowNodeRef>
      </lane>
      <lane id="lane_sm" name="Service Management">
        <flowNodeRef>start_sm_msg</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_sm_investigate</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>gateway_sm_analyzable</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_sm_send_rp_report</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_sm_analyze</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_sm_create_trouble_report</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_sm_receive_status</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>gateway_sm_merge_status</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_sm_prepare_final_status</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>gateway_sm_action_path</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_sm_send_perf_cs</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>end_sm_no_prob</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_sm_minor_actions</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_sm_create_resolution_rep</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_sm_send_resolution_cs</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>end_sm_minor</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_sm_create_restoration_req</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_sm_send_restoration_req</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_sm_receive_ts_report</flowNodeRef>
      </lane>
      <lane id="lane_rp" name="Resource Provisioning">
        <flowNodeRef>start_rp_msg</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_rp_check_problems</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>gateway_rp_prob_detected</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_rp_create_normal_exec</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_rp_analyze</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_rp_create_trouble_report</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>gateway_rp_merge_rep</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_rp_send_status</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>gateway_rp_event_based</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>catch_rp_restoration_req</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>catch_rp_2days_timer</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>end_rp_timeout</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_rp_track_errors</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_rp_corrective_actions</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_rp_create_ts_report</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>task_rp_send_ts_report</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>end_rp_restored</flowNodeRef>
      </lane>
    </laneSet>

    <!-- ================= Customer Service Lane Elements ================= -->
    <startEvent id="start_cs_msg" name="Receive Problem Parameters">
      <messageEventDefinition id="med_cs_start" />
      <outgoing>flow_cs_1</outgoing>
    </startEvent>

    <userTask id="task_cs_enter_report" name="Enter Problem Report into System T">
      <incoming>flow_cs_1</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_cs_2</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <userTask id="task_cs_compare_sla" name="Compare Report to Customer SLA">
      <incoming>flow_cs_2</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_cs_3</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <userTask id="task_cs_determine_countermeasures" name="Determine Counter Measures & Priorities">
      <incoming>flow_cs_3</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_cs_4</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <serviceTask id="task_cs_determine_significance" name="Determine Customer Significance">
      <incoming>flow_cs_4</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_cs_5</outgoing>
    </serviceTask>

    <exclusiveGateway id="gateway_cs_premium" name="Is Premium Customer?">
      <incoming>flow_cs_5</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_cs_prem_yes</outgoing>
      <outgoing>flow_cs_prem_no</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>

    <callActivity id="call_cs_extra_fix" name="Link to Extra Problem Fix Process">
      <incoming>flow_cs_prem_yes</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_cs_6</outgoing>
    </callActivity>

    <exclusiveGateway id="gateway_cs_reprioritize_check" name="Significance Affects Counter Measures?">
      <incoming>flow_cs_prem_no</incoming>
      <incoming>flow_cs_6</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_cs_reprep_yes</outgoing>
      <outgoing>flow_cs_reprep_no</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>

    <userTask id="task_cs_reprioritize" name="Re-prioritize Counter Measures">
      <incoming>flow_cs_reprep_yes</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_cs_7</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <exclusiveGateway id="gateway_cs_merge_reprioritize">
      <incoming>flow_cs_reprep_no</incoming>
      <incoming>flow_cs_7</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_cs_8</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>

    <userTask id="task_cs_create_detailed_report" name="Create Detailed Problem Report">
      <incoming>flow_cs_8</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_cs_9</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <sendTask id="task_cs_send_detailed_report" name="Send Detailed Problem Report to Service Management">
      <incoming>flow_cs_9</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_cs_10</outgoing>
    </sendTask>

    <exclusiveGateway id="gateway_cs_receive_type" name="Wait for Service Management Response">
      <incoming>flow_cs_10</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_cs_to_perf</outgoing>
      <outgoing>flow_cs_to_res</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>

    <intermediateCatchEvent id="catch_cs_actual_perf" name="Receive Actual Service Performance">
      <incoming>flow_cs_to_perf</incoming>
      <messageEventDefinition id="med_cs_perf" />
      <outgoing>flow_cs_perf_rcvd</outgoing>
    </intermediateCatchEvent>

    <intermediateCatchEvent id="catch_cs_resolution_rep" name="Receive Problem Resolution Report">
      <incoming>flow_cs_to_res</incoming>
      <messageEventDefinition id="med_cs_res" />
      <outgoing>flow_cs_res_rcvd</outgoing>
    </intermediateCatchEvent>

    <exclusiveGateway id="gateway_cs_merge_received">
      <incoming>flow_cs_perf_rcvd</incoming>
      <incoming>flow_cs_res_rcvd</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_cs_11</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>

    <parallelGateway id="gateway_cs_parallel_split">
      <incoming>flow_cs_11</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_cs_p1</outgoing>
      <outgoing>flow_cs_p2</outgoing>
    </parallelGateway>

    <userTask id="task_cs_create_cust_report" name="Create Customer Performance & Resolution Report">
      <incoming>flow_cs_p1</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_cs_12</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <sendTask id="task_cs_send_report_cust" name="Send Report to Customer">
      <incoming>flow_cs_12</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_cs_p1_done</outgoing>
    </sendTask>

    <sendTask id="task_cs_report_rebate" name="Report SLA Violation Rebate to Billing">
      <incoming>flow_cs_p2</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_cs_p2_done</outgoing>
    </sendTask>

    <parallelGateway id="gateway_cs_parallel_join">
      <incoming>flow_cs_p1_done</incoming>
      <incoming>flow_cs_p2_done</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_cs_13</outgoing>
    </parallelGateway>

    <endEvent id="end_cs" name="Customer Service Process Completed">
      <incoming>flow_cs_13</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <!-- Sequence Flows: CS -->
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_cs_1" sourceRef="start_cs_msg" targetRef="task_cs_enter_report" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_cs_2" sourceRef="task_cs_enter_report" targetRef="task_cs_compare_sla" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_cs_3" sourceRef="task_cs_compare_sla" targetRef="task_cs_determine_countermeasures" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_cs_4" sourceRef="task_cs_determine_countermeasures" targetRef="task_cs_determine_significance" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_cs_5" sourceRef="task_cs_determine_significance" targetRef="gateway_cs_premium" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_cs_prem_yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="gateway_cs_premium" targetRef="call_cs_extra_fix" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_cs_prem_no" name="No" sourceRef="gateway_cs_premium" targetRef="gateway_cs_reprioritize_check" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_cs_6" sourceRef="call_cs_extra_fix" targetRef="gateway_cs_reprioritize_check" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_cs_reprep_yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="gateway_cs_reprioritize_check" targetRef="task_cs_reprioritize" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_cs_reprep_no" name="No" sourceRef="gateway_cs_reprioritize_check" targetRef="gateway_cs_merge_reprioritize" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_cs_7" sourceRef="task_cs_reprioritize" targetRef="gateway_cs_merge_reprioritize" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_cs_8" sourceRef="gateway_cs_merge_reprioritize" targetRef="task_cs_create_detailed_report" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_cs_9" sourceRef="task_cs_create_detailed_report" targetRef="task_cs_send_detailed_report" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_cs_10" sourceRef="task_cs_send_detailed_report" targetRef="gateway_cs_receive_type" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_cs_to_perf" sourceRef="gateway_cs_receive_type" targetRef="catch_cs_actual_perf" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_cs_to_res" sourceRef="gateway_cs_receive_type" targetRef="catch_cs_resolution_rep" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_cs_perf_rcvd" sourceRef="catch_cs_actual_perf" targetRef="gateway_cs_merge_received" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_cs_res_rcvd" sourceRef="catch_cs_resolution_rep" targetRef="gateway_cs_merge_received" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_cs_11" sourceRef="gateway_cs_merge_received" targetRef="gateway_cs_parallel_split" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_cs_p1" sourceRef="gateway_cs_parallel_split" targetRef="task_cs_create_cust_report" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_cs_12" sourceRef="task_cs_create_cust_report" targetRef="task_cs_send_report_cust" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_cs_p1_done" sourceRef="task_cs_send_report_cust" targetRef="gateway_cs_parallel_join" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_cs_p2" sourceRef="gateway_cs_parallel_split" targetRef="task_cs_report_rebate" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_cs_p2_done" sourceRef="task_cs_report_rebate" targetRef="gateway_cs_parallel_join" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_cs_13" sourceRef="gateway_cs_parallel_join" targetRef="end_cs" />

    <!-- ================= Service Management Lane Elements ================= -->
    <startEvent id="start_sm_msg" name="Receive Detailed Problem Report">
      <messageEventDefinition id="med_sm_start" />
      <outgoing>flow_sm_1</outgoing>
    </startEvent>

    <userTask id="task_sm_investigate" name="Investigate Problem Location">
      <incoming>flow_sm_1</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_sm_2</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <exclusiveGateway id="gateway_sm_analyzable" name="Analyzable by Service Management?">

      <outgoing>flow_sm_no</outgoing>
      <outgoing>flow_sm_yes</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>

    <sendTask id="task_sm_send_rp_report" name="Send Detailed Problem Report to Resource Provisioning">

      <outgoing>flow_sm_3</outgoing>
    </sendTask>

    <receiveTask id="task_sm_receive_status" name="Receive Status Report from RP">
      <incoming>flow_sm_3</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_sm_4</outgoing>
    </receiveTask>

    <userTask id="task_sm_analyze" name="Perform Service Analysis">
      <incoming>flow_sm_yes</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_sm_5</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <userTask id="task_sm_create_trouble_report" name="Create Trouble Report">
      <incoming>flow_sm_5</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_sm_6</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <exclusiveGateway id="gateway_sm_merge_status">
      <incoming>flow_sm_4</incoming>
      <incoming>flow_sm_6</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_sm_7</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>

    <userTask id="task_sm_prepare_final_status" name="Prepare Final Status Report">
      <incoming>flow_sm_7</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_sm_8</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <exclusiveGateway id="gateway_sm_action_path" name="Determine Required Action">
      <incoming>flow_sm_8</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_sm_path_noprob</outgoing>
      <outgoing>flow_sm_path_minor</outgoing>
      <outgoing>flow_sm_path_auto</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Path 1: No problem -->
    <sendTask id="task_sm_send_perf_cs" name="Send Actual Service Performance to CS">
      <incoming>flow_sm_path_noprob</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_sm_9</outgoing>
    </sendTask>

    <endEvent id="end_sm_no_prob" name="Ended (No Problem)">
      <incoming>flow_sm_9</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <!-- Path 2: Minor actions -->
    <userTask id="task_sm_minor_actions" name="Undertake Minor Corrective Actions">
      <incoming>flow_sm_path_minor</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_sm_10</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <userTask id="task_sm_create_resolution_rep" name="Create Problem Resolution Report">
      <incoming>flow_sm_10</incoming>
      <incoming>flow_sm_14</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_sm_11</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <sendTask id="task_sm_send_resolution_cs" name="Send Problem Resolution Report to CS">
      <incoming>flow_sm_11</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_sm_12</outgoing>

    <endEvent id="end_sm_minor" name="Ended (Minor Actions)">
